title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI purchases through retailer checkouts
description:
OpenAI is giving its artificial intelligence (AI) shopping agents a way to pay through retailers’ checkout systems, marking another shift in the ChatGPT maker’s evolving agentic commerce strategy. Launched Nov. 13 in partnership with American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa, ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s “always-on” personal agents, known as dots, complete purchases on shoppers’ behalf. […]

title: Claude AI for marketing: How teams use it with HubSpot
description: I’ve been experimenting with Claude AI for marketing workflows over the past year, and it’s now my go-to assistant. In this field, AI use is close to universal: 98% of marketing teams use it in some way, according to HubSpot’s State of AI in Marketing report. For campaign marketers, that might look like turning a product announcement into a week of social posts, tightening ad copy to fit character limits, or pressure-testing campaign messaging before a stakeholder review.
